name: Tuna & Sweetcorn Salad Pot
method: Put the salad leaves in a lunchbox or tub and add the halved tomatoes and sliced cucumber.
Drain the tuna and sweetcorn and mix them with the yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Spoon the tuna mix on top and serve with a pitta, or put the lid on and keep it chilled for later.
